title: user.reactivated (v2)
description: A user account returned to active. Emitted when an administrator sets the account state to "active" (from suspended, locked, recovery_restricted, or pending_deletion, which cancels a scheduled deletion), and automatically (reason FACTOR_ASSURANCE_RESTORED) when a recovery-restricted account signs in with TOTP or a passkey or enrolls a new one. Previously revoked sessions and grants are not restored. A user cancelling their own pending deletion does not emit this event. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The user whose account state changed.

organization_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.

x-emitted-by: internal/authentication/steps.go: (*Service).complete (strong-factor sign-in of a recovery-restricted account)
internal/httpapi/selfservice.go: restoreAssuranceTx (new TOTP or passkey enrollment)
